answer: Admission auction: slots are sold. Epochs auction slots; the clearing price sets one identity's cost. An attacker wanting 100 identities must outbid honest entrants 100 times, each bid lifting the price, so the nebula of fake demand shows as one price. Winners pay a mesa fee, locked 20 epochs, refunded after honest work. The canyon between one identity and a hundred fakes: at a 40-unit clearing price, 100 x 40 = 4,000 against a 900-unit pool.
